text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic young adult male character. Ash-blond tousled wavy fringe, light gray-green eyes, fair skin, slender youthful face, clean shaven; dark charcoal V-neck sweater, pale blue shirt, navy tiny geometric tie. Lower outfit: charcoal tailored trousers, black leather penny loafers. Three full-length photographs of the same adult man in one horizontal sheet: front, exact image-right-facing profile, exact back. Identical clothing, body proportions and head scale; 8–8.5-head athletic adult proportions, natural healthy long legs, arms at sides, empty hands. Entire hair and shoes visible, aligned crown heights and shoe baseline, generous margins. Pure white studio, subtle contact shadows, landscape 3:2, no text. Preserve a consistent individual face and hairstyle across all views. High-detail photographic skin, anatomically natural features, no watermarks, interfaces, logos or text.
original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: 全身三视图. Create a THREE-VIEW full-length turnaround sheet of the same person in the first input full-body image. Second input is the approved face identity. Left: front; center: exact 90-degree side profile facing image-right; right: exact back facing away. Keep first input's exact outfit, footwear, build, leg-to-torso ratio, leg thickness, height and head-to-body scale identical across all views. Entire hair and footwear visible with generous margins, all three shoes aligned on one baseline, same crown height. Neutral stance, arms relaxed at sides, empty hands. Neutral face and eye-level perspective, no leaning or posing. Landscape native 1536x1024, pure white seamless studio and subtle foot contact shadows. Exactly three figures of ONE identity, no text or labels.
IDENTITY: Ash-blond tousled wavy fringe, light gray-green eyes, fair skin, slender youthful face, clean shaven; dark charcoal V-neck sweater, pale blue shirt, navy tiny geometric tie.
LOWER OUTFIT: charcoal tailored trousers, black leather penny loafers.
Preserve the exact individual face, skull and jaw shape, eye color, hair color, hairstyle, apparent adult age, skin tone, and existing accessories of the supplied portrait. Different views are the SAME person, never a lookalike or a blended generic face. Realistic bright neutral studio photography with detailed natural pores and individual hair strands, accurate fine cloth weave, pure white seamless background, neutral color, no painterly/swirl texture, no plastic skin, no text, no labels, no watermark. 
Use the attached approved image as the authoritative visual reference. Preserve all visible garment, collar, jewelry and hair details; infer unseen rear clothing construction consistently. Do not add props or new accessories.
